facts.claim: Lindos Royal Resort's own 'Weddings & Honeymoon' page invites couples to 'Host your extraordinary wedding at Lindos Royal Resort', describing charming Mediterranean architecture, a setting 'nestled along a stunning beach', multiple pools and a diverse selection of restaurants. The site is part of Lindos Hotels Group.

Lindos Royal Resort says its wedding planner will assist with organising the ceremony and takes care of all wedding details 'based on your own taste and desires', and that wedding, honeymoon and proposal packages are available on request from its sales department. The page describes weddings as 'glamorous, intimate or cozy'. No ceremony locations, guest capacity, room count or exclusive use are published.

insider_details.detail: Lindos Royal publishes no ceremony spaces or capacities, so ask its sales team for named ceremony and reception spaces, seated and standing numbers and the room count before shortlisting it against venues that publish these.
